set1:169.activation: SPELL: Void Portal: SEEK 4. Set the card found. It gains DOOM.

set1:170.name: Madness Policy
set1:170.activation: SKILL: Move Madness Policy to an open zone an opponent controls: each player sacrifices their cards directly facing an opponent's card.

set1:171.name: Frog Trophy
set1:171.text:
RITUAL: Sacrifice 1.
MOVE: Expend Frog Trophy: a card gains FRAGILE.

set1:172.name: Living Home
set1:172.text:
ENTER: Attach a card from your hand to Living Home.
PERISH: Set a card attached to Living Home used.
set1:172.activation: SKILL: Set a LVL 2 or lower non-spell Golem used.

set1:173.name: Swarm
set1:173.activation: SPELL: Void up to 3 LVL 0 cards from your discard: set them at the end of the turn.

set1:174.name: Star Shower
set1:174.activation: SPELL: Fill all open back-row zones with Celestial 1FORCE/DOOM tokens. Sacrifice them at the end of the turn.

set1:175.name: Particle Cannon
set1:175.activation: SKILL: Use only while Particle Cannon is in the front row. Destroy a card directly facing Particle Cannon. Cannot be used as a response.

set1:176.name: Withering Shrine
set1:176.activation: ASSIST: Discard 3: set a card discarded this way. It gains DOOM.

set1:177.name: Blood Rock
set1:177.activation: REUSE: Lose 1 life: move up to 2FORCE from one card you control to another.

set1:178.name: Tunnel of White Wind
set1:178.text:
END: Add 1CHARGE to Tunnel of White Wind.
When a card enters under an opponent's control, you may remove 1CHARGE from Tunnel of White Wind: move that card to an open zone an opponent controls.

set1:179.name: Void Pointer
set1:179.text:
ENTER: Void the top 3 cards of your deck.
PERISH: Add a card voided by Void Pointer to your hand.
set1:179.activation: SKILL: Deal 1 damage to a card.

set1:180.name: Sea Sick
set1:180.activation: SPELL: Destroy a front-row card, then create a used Fish 1NULL token in the same zone.

set1:181.name: Creation From Nothing
set1:181.text: Once per turn, when a card is voided, attach it to Creation From Nothing.
set1:181.activation: SKILL: Set a card attached to Creation From Nothing.

set1:182.name: Boil
set1:182.activation: SPELL: Deal 2 damage to a card and 1 non-lethal damage to adjacent cards its owner controls.

set1:183.name: Last Mass
set1:183.text: When you discard one or more cards, Last Mass gains +1FORCE

set1:184.name: Last Chance
set1:184.text:
ENTER: Choose a card you control.
When it perishes, you may sacrifice Last Chance: set the chosen card used.

set1:185.name: Stingling
set1:185.activation: ASSIST: Sacrifice any number of Bugs: deal that much damage to a card.

set1:186.name: Pheromone Den
set1:186.text: Cards with 1FORCE deal 1 additional combat damage.

set1:187.name: Red Wizard
set1:187.text: PERISH: Return one of Red Wizard's attachments you don't own to its owner's hand.
set1:187.activation: SKILL: Attach a back-row card in Red Wizard's column to Red Wizard.

set1:188.name: Death Pact
set1:188.text: Once per turn, when you sacrifice one or more cards, deal that much damage to anything.

set1:189.name: Prophecy of Plague
set1:189.text:
PERISH: All cards take SICK damage.
Front-row cards have SICK.

set1:190.name: Drill Master
set1:190.text: VICTOR: If Drill Master destroyed a card, you may destroy a LVL 1 or lower back-row card.

set1:191.name: Border of Life
set1:191.text: Other used cards you control cannot be destroyed outside of combat.

set1:192.name: Rat Mother
set1:192.text: VICTOR: Fill your opponents' open zones with Rat 1FORCE tokens.
set1:192.activation: SPELL: Sacrifice all Rat tokens: deal that much damage to anything.

set1:193.name: False Queen's Carcass
set1:193.activation: SKILL: Sacrifice 2 other cards: up to 2 other cards gain FRAGILE.

set1:194.name: Saturn Bear
set1:194.text: VICTOR: You may create a Celestial 1FORCE/DOOM token.

set1:196.name: Malignant Box
set1:196.activation: SKILL: Deal 3 non-lethal damage to your opponents' front-row cards.

set1:197.name: Cauldron of Chaos
set1:197.text: RITUAL: Must have at least 5 cards in your discard.
set1:197.activation: SKILL: Choose 3 cards from players' discards. An opponent you choose sets 1 of them. Set the other 2.

set1:198.name: Sun Box
set1:198.text: BEGIN: Deal damage equal to the size of your void to an opponent's card, or to them if they control none.
set1:198.activation: SKILL: Discard 3 from your void: destroy a card.

set1:199.name: Spiritual Warlord
set1:199.text:
VICTOR: Set a LVL 1 or lower non-spell card from your discard used.
Once per turn, when a Ghost perishes,  a card you control gains +1FORCE.

set1:200.name: Serendipity
set1:200.text:
VICTOR: If Serendipity dealt damage to a player, that player MILLs that many cards..
Once per turn, when an opponent discards a card, Serendipity gains +2FORCE.
set1:200.activation: SKILL: All players MILL 1. You may move Serendipity to an open zone you control.

set1:201.name: Moon Angel
set1:201.text: When a non-token card you control perishes, add 1CHARGE to Moon Angel.
set1:201.activation: SKILL: Remove all CHARGE from Moon Angel: deal that much damage to your opponents' front-row cards.

set1:202.name: Ethereal Witch
set1:202.text:
RITUAL: Discard a spell card.
Once per turn, when you activate a spell, SEEK 3.
set1:202.activation: SPELL: Void 2 spell cards from your discard: destroy an opponent's card.

set1:203.name: Monolith
set1:203.text: END: Monolith gains FORCE equal to your hand size, up to +3FORCE.
set1:203.activation: REUSE: Monolith takes 2 damage: other front-row cards you control gain +1FORCE.

set1:204.name: Abyssal Maw
set1:204.text:
VICTOR: If Abyssal Maw destroyed a card, deal 1 damage to anything.
When a card you control perishes, add 1CHARGE to Abyssal Maw.
set1:204.activation: REUSE: Remove 2CHARGE from Abyssal Maw and sacrifice 1: Abyssal Maw gains +2FORCE.

set1:205.name: Void World
set1:205.text:
RITUAL: Void a card you control.
ENTER: SEEK 3.
Other cards you control in the center column deal 1 additional combat damage and have IMMORTAL.

set1:206.name: Black Hole
set1:206.text: Once per turn, when you void a card, an opponent voids a card they control.
set1:206.activation: REUSE: Void a ready card you control: Black Hole gains +1FORCE.

set1:207.name: Combat Idol
set1:207.text: Once per turn, when you declare an attack, the attacker gains +1FORCE.

set1:208.name: It Gets Worse
set1:208.activation: SPELL: Destroy up to 2 SICK cards.

set1:209.name: Barrier Lord
set1:209.text:
Barrier Lord cannot gain FORCE.
When an adjacent card takes damage, Barrier Lord takes the damage instead.

set1:210.name: Ghost Bomb
set1:210.text: RITUAL: Must have at least 10 cards in your discard.
set1:210.activation: SPELL: Set up to 3 other non-spell cards from your discard used. Lose 1 life for each card set this way.

set1:211.name: Crow Devourer
set1:211.text:
ENTER: Sacrifice any number of Birds you control: attach those cards to Crow Devourer.
VICTOR: If Crow Devourer destroyed a card, attach it to Crow Devourer.
Crow Devourer deals additional combat damage equal to the number of cards attached to it.

set1:212.name: Marlita Red to Blue
set1:212.text:
RITUAL: Sacrifice one or more Magic cards.
ENTER: This card gains +2FORCE for each card sacrificed for its ritual.
set1:212.activation: SKILL: Void a Magic card from your discard: add up to 2 Magic cards from your discard to your hand.

set1:213.name: Horror From Above
set1:213.text:
RITUAL: Sacrifice 1.
ENTER: A front-row card you control gains +1FORCE for each time Horror From Above has been played this turn.

set1:214.name: Wetaphemesis
set1:214.text:
END: Sacrifice a Bug.
When one or more Bugs exit your discard, Wetaphemesis gains +1FORCE.
set1:214.activation: SKILL: Set 2 LVL 1 or lower non-spell cards from your discard used.

set1:215.name: Ethereal Archmage
set1:215.text:
ENTER: Discard your hand.
END: Set a card voided by Ethereal Archmage.
set1:215.activation: SKILL: Void up to 2 spell cards from any player's discard: deal that much damage to a player or twice that much to a card.

set1:216.name: Lord of Hands
set1:216.text: RITUAL: Must have at least 5 cards in your discard.
set1:216.activation: SKILL: Set a card from your discard used. If you set a Ghost, you may destroy a back-row card. If you set a Golem, destroy a front-row card.

set1:217.name: Toxician
set1:217.text:
RITUAL: A SICK card must be in play.
Toxician cannot take SICK damage.

set1:218.name: Ouroboros
set1:218.text:
PERISH: You may void 2 cards from your hand: set Ouroboros with DOOM.
When another non-token card you control perishes, you may void cards from your hand equal to its LVL + 1: set it.

set1:219.name: Void Saviour
set1:219.text:
RITUAL: Void 2 cards you control.
ENTER: Deal 1 damage to all opponents.

set1:220.name: The Moon
set1:220.activation: SKILL: This turn, other cards you control have IMMORTAL.

set1:221.name: Landterra
set1:221.text:
RITUAL: Cannot be played in the front-row.
BEGIN: If Landterra has 3 or more Gold Leaf counters, it stops being passive and other cards you control have IMMORTAL.
Once per turn, when a card exits your discard, add 1 Gold Leaf counter to Landterra. Another card you control gains +1FORCE.

set1:222.name: Mineral God
set1:222.activation: SKILL: Sacrifice all other back-row cards you control: front-row cards you control gain that much FORCE this turn. HEAL that much.

set1:223.name: Godless Vessel
set1:223.text:
RITUAL: Sacrifice 2.
BEGIN: Sacrifice 1.
VICTOR: If Godless Vessel dealt damage to an opponent, they lose the game.

set1:224.name: Mechanical Messiah
set1:224.text:
RITUAL: Sacrifice 3.
ENTER: You may set a LVL 1 card.
BEGIN: Another card you control gains +1FORCE.
END: You may deal 2 non-lethal damage to a card.
VICTOR: You may void a card you control: draw 2.
PERISH: You may sacrifice 1: HEAL 2.
